sections.heading: B — Lane markings, passing and turning
sections.markdown:
## Audience and source scope
Teach first-time passenger-car drivers how line colors and patterns relate to lane direction, passing and turning. Connect the shared center lane's left-turn purpose with the prohibition on acceleration there. Keep pedestrian right of way and stop-line placement distinct from lane-choice rules.

sections.heading: C — Lane markings, passing and turning
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec06-F01 | anchor: A43
Pavement lines and symbols separate lanes and identify passing, turning, stopping, and pedestrian-crossing locations. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F02 | anchor: A43
The solid white line at the roadside marks the roadway's outside edge. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F03 | anchor: A43
A broken white lane line separates traffic moving in the same direction and may be crossed for a safe lane change. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F04 | anchor: A43
A broken yellow center line permits passing across it when opposing traffic is absent and passing is safe. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F05 | anchor: A43
Double solid yellow lines divide opposing traffic and prohibit passing from either direction. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F06 | anchor: A43
A solid yellow center line may be crossed for a driveway turn when no opposing vehicle is approaching the turn location. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F07 | anchor: A44
A shared center turn lane serves left turns for traffic traveling in either direction. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F08 | anchor: A44
A driver turning left from a driveway or side street may use the shared center turn lane as part of entering or merging with traffic. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F09 | anchor: A44
The shared center left-turn lane must not be used to accelerate into traffic. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F10 | anchor: A44
Backing a vehicle in a travel lane is both unsafe and illegal. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F11 | anchor: A44
After missing an exit or turn, keep going until a safe place to turn around is available rather than backing up. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F12 | anchor: A44
Do not stop in a travel lane to handle confusion, a breakdown, or a passenger drop-off; pull safely off the road. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F13 | anchor: A44
On a road with at least three same-direction lanes, use the right lane except when passing. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F14 | anchor: A44
When substantial merging traffic is present on a road with at least three same-direction lanes, the guide recommends the center travel lane. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F15 | anchor: A44
Driving on the shoulder is prohibited unless a police officer directs you to do so. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F16 | anchor: A44
Never use the shoulder to pass another vehicle, whether the shoulder is paved or unpaved. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F17 | anchor: A44
On a multilane roadway, the far-left lane is intended for overtaking slower vehicles. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F18 | anchor: A45
Without turning-control signs or lane markings, turn into the lane nearest your direction of travel. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-F19 | anchor: A45
Keep a right turn from swinging into the opposing traffic lane. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-F20 | anchor: A45
Do not cut the corner during a left turn, because a sharply cut turn can strike a vehicle approaching from the left. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-F21 | anchor: A45
Leave space for an oncoming vehicle to make its own left turn in front of you. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-F22 | anchor: A46
When another vehicle is traveling beside you on a multilane road, move ahead of it or fall behind it rather than remaining alongside. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F23 | anchor: A46
If a vehicle follows too closely on a multilane road, move into the lane to your right when that lane is clear. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F24 | anchor: A46
When approaching a stop sign with a marked stop line, bring your vehicle to a complete stop before reaching the line [A46].
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0046]

sections.heading: C2 — Lane markings, passing and turning
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A44
Shared center turn lanes have alternating left-turn arrows for vehicles arriving from opposite directions. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A44
When lane-use signs and markings are absent, the general lane rules still govern driving, passing, and turning. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A44
Passing on the shoulder is dangerous because another driver may pull onto that shoulder without expecting a vehicle there. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A45
A wide right turn may mislead a following driver into thinking you are moving left, prompting that driver to try passing on your right. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A46
Yield to a pedestrian who is already in a crosswalk or is about to enter it. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A46
Crosswalks are not always marked, so watch for pedestrians even at intersections without painted crosswalks. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A46
A pedestrian using a guide dog or carrying a white cane must receive absolute right of way. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A46
When overtaking vehicles on a multi-lane road, the far-left lane is meant for passing slower vehicles [A46].
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-ar-class-d:arkansas-state-police-asp-driver-examina:handbook:pdf-0046]
